crownPassive.name: The wooden horse
crownPassive.text: In round 1, all your cards except Odysseus are hidden from the enemy.

bond.name: Men of Ithaca
bond.text: When one of your front-rank slots is empty at upkeep, a Villager fills it. Once per fight for each Hellas hero you field.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard Ranged attack: damage equal to Attack, on any enemy card.

actions.name: Nobody
actions.text: The first attack aimed at Odysseus this round misses, and the attacker takes 1 damage. Not Speed dependent: if chosen, it is up before anyone acts. Once per fight.
